Names a series with a marker and a label. Dot for points and bars, Square for areas, Line and Dashed for lines and forecasts. 4 variants.

A forecast, target or range needs to be told apart from the data.
Skip it for a single series — the chart title already names it.

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Order items exactly as the series are drawn (top → bottom, left → right).
Web and Tablet: legend above the plot, right-aligned with the title row. Mobile: below the plot, wraps.
Marker colour is always the series token — dataviz/categorical/01…08 in order.
Max 6 items; group the rest as “Other”.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Names a series with a marker and a label. Dot for points and bars, Square for areas, Line and Dashed for lines and forecasts.
Encoding
marker colour ← series.color · marker style ← series.mark · label ← series.label
Interaction
Click / tap toggles the series; Shift+click isolates it. Hover highlights the series and mutes the others (dataviz/*, 30%).
Accessibility
Rendered as a list of toggle buttons with aria-pressed; colour is always paired with the label text.
